reference_metadata.position_and_velocity: NED [north,east,down] converted to ENU [east,north,up]; position is relative to the first sample
reference_metadata.attitude: PX4 FRD-to-NED quaternion converted to project FLU-to-ENU
reference_metadata.motor_input: PX4 actuator_motors.control is normalized thrust; samples are linearly interpolated at 60 Hz
reference_metadata.initial_motor_speed: estimated as sqrt(normalized_thrust) times the configured maximum speed; this is not measured RPM
